items.title: Giannis Scores 34 as Heat Block 14 Shots and Beat Pistons
items.titleZh: 字母哥 34 分、熱火 14 次阻攻 擊敗活塞拿下四連勝
items.teaser: 開季 0 勝 4 敗的熱火，13 場後戰績已經翻正！字母哥 34 分 14 籃板，湯普森傷癒歸隊投進 6 記三分，熱火全隊 14 次阻攻只差隊史紀錄 1 次。
paras: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 34 points, grabbed 14 rebounds and added eight assists as the Miami Heat beat the Detroit Pistons 137-117 on Saturday night. It was Miami's fourth straight win. Antetokounmpo scored 71 points in two days, after putting up 37 in a win over Cleveland on Friday.
字母哥安特托昆波（Giannis Antetokounmpo）週六晚上攻下 34 分、14 籃板，還有 8 次助攻，帶領邁阿密熱火以 137 比 117 擊敗底特律活塞。這是熱火的四連勝。字母哥兩天內合計拿下 71 分，週五對克里夫蘭騎士的勝仗中他就已經攻下 37 分。

Klay Thompson returned from a sprained ankle and scored 26 points, including six 3-pointers. Bam Adebayo added 20 points. Nine Heat players blocked at least one shot, and the team finished with 14 blocks, just one short of the franchise record. For Detroit, Cade Cunningham scored 33 points with eight assists, and Kevin Huerter had 20.
湯普森（Klay Thompson）從腳踝扭傷中復出，攻下 26 分，其中包括 6 記三分球。阿德巴約（Bam Adebayo）也貢獻 20 分。熱火有 9 名球員至少送出一次阻攻，全隊共 14 次阻攻，只差隊史紀錄一次。活塞方面，康寧漢（Cade Cunningham）拿下 33 分、8 助攻，赫爾特（Kevin Huerter）得 20 分。

Miami lost its first four games this season but has now won seven of its last nine to improve to 7-6. According to the report, the Heat are only the fourth team in the last 25 seasons to start 0-4 and still have a winning record after 13 games. Detroit fell to 8-4.
熱火本季開季吞下四連敗，但近九場拿下七勝，戰績提升到 7 勝 6 敗。根據報導，熱火是近 25 個球季以來，第四支開季 0 勝 4 敗、卻在 13 場後戰績高於五成的球隊。活塞則降到 8 勝 4 敗。

items.title: Judge Lets DRAM Price-Fixing Lawsuit Against Chipmakers Move Forward
items.titleZh: 法官拒絕駁回 三大記憶體廠須面對 DRAM 聯合漲價訴訟
items.teaser: 記憶體價格 18 個月漲了將近 7 倍，是 AI 需求造成，還是三大廠串通？美國法官認為原告的說法「合理可信」，三星、SK 海力士和美光得上法院說清楚。
paras: A federal judge in California has refused to dismiss a lawsuit that accuses Samsung, SK hynix and Micron of working together to limit the supply of DRAM memory chips. The three companies took more than 91% of global DRAM revenue in the third quarter of 2025. The case was brought by 17 consumers and small businesses that bought PCs, laptops and memory kits.
美國加州一名聯邦法官拒絕駁回一起訴訟；這起訴訟指控三星、SK 海力士和美光聯手限制 DRAM 記憶體晶片的供應。這三家公司在 2025 年第三季拿下全球超過 91% 的 DRAM 營收。提告的是 17 位購買電腦、筆電和記憶體套件的消費者與小型企業。

The plaintiffs point to a 697% price rise over 18 months. They say the companies cut production, stopped making older DDR4 chips at about the same time, and refused long-term supply deals for regular DRAM while focusing on HBM for AI customers. The companies argue that they were simply reacting to falling prices and then to AI demand.
原告指出，記憶體價格在 18 個月內上漲了 697%。他們說，這幾家公司減產、幾乎同時停產較舊的 DDR4 晶片，而且拒絕簽訂一般 DRAM 的長期供貨合約，同時把重心放在供應 AI 客戶的 HBM 上。這幾家公司則主張，他們只是因應價格下跌、後來又因應 AI 需求而做出調整。

Judge Noël Wise said the conspiracy claims were plausible and described the companies' behavior as "more akin to hawks flying in formation." This does not mean that anyone has been found liable. The companies must respond by December 7, and the first case management conference is set for January 12, 2027.
法官 Noël Wise 表示，原告關於串通的指控合理可信，並形容這幾家公司的行為「更像是排成隊形飛行的老鷹」。這並不代表任何一方已被判定須負法律責任。三家公司必須在 12 月 7 日前提出答辯，第一次案件管理會議則訂在 2027 年 1 月 12 日。

items.title: New Taipei Mayor Race: Su and Lee Hold Weekend Campaign Events
items.titleZh: 新北市長選戰倒數 蘇巧慧、李四川週末各自造勢
items.teaser: 11 月 28 日地方選舉進入最後兩週，新北市長選戰由民進黨蘇巧慧對上國民黨李四川，兩人週日分別和副總統蕭美琴、市長侯友宜一起拜票。
paras: With Taiwan's local elections set for Nov. 28, the two main candidates for New Taipei mayor held campaign events on Sunday. New Taipei, a city of about 4 million people, has been governed by the Kuomintang (KMT) since 2010. Mayor Hou Yu-ih cannot run again because of term limits.
台灣地方選舉將在 11 月 28 日舉行，新北市長的兩位主要候選人週日都舉辦了競選活動。新北市約有 400 萬人口，自 2010 年起一直由國民黨執政。現任市長侯友宜因為任期限制，不能再參選。

Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) candidate Su Chiao-hui, 50, held a rally in Zhonghe and Yonghe with Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim. Su praised the area's mix of cultures, saying, "Diversity is New Taipei's strength." She promised urban renewal that also protects local history and asked voters to support the DPP's city council candidates.
民進黨候選人、50 歲的蘇巧慧和副總統蕭美琴在中和、永和舉辦造勢活動。蘇巧慧稱讚當地多元文化交融，表示「多元是新北的力量」。她承諾推動兼顧在地歷史的都市更新，並請選民支持民進黨的市議員候選人。

KMT candidate Lee Shu-chuan, 68, campaigned with Hou in Sanchong and promised to build on Hou's eight-year record. "I will certainly take up the baton," Lee said. He proposed a mayor-led committee to speed up urban renewal and pledged to start building the New Taipei Dome in Shulin within four years.
國民黨候選人、68 歲的李四川和侯友宜一起在三重拜票，承諾延續侯友宜八年的施政成果。李四川說：「我一定會接下這一棒。」他提議成立由市長主導的委員會，加快都市更新流程，並承諾四年內讓樹林的新北巨蛋動工。

items.title: Did Dinosaurs Eat Seaweed? Fossil Teeth Offer a Clue
items.titleZh: 恐龍也吃海藻？牙齒化石透露一億年前的海岸菜單
items.teaser: 科學家分析恐龍、鱷魚、烏龜和魚的牙齒化石，發現住在海邊的動物可能靠著被沖上岸的海藻「加菜」：陸地和海洋的食物網，早在一億多年前就連在一起了。
paras: Some dinosaurs living near the coast may have eaten food that came from the sea, a new study suggests. Researchers studied fossil teeth from dinosaurs, crocodiles, turtles and fish that lived more than 100 million years ago. The fossils came from sites along the Western Interior Seaway, an ancient sea, and the ancient coastline of the Gulf of Mexico.
一項新研究指出，有些住在海岸附近的恐龍，可能吃過來自海洋的食物。研究人員分析了一億多年前的恐龍、鱷魚、烏龜和魚的牙齒化石。這些化石來自古代海洋「西部內陸海道」沿岸，以及古墨西哥灣的海岸線一帶。

The team measured carbon isotopes in the tooth enamel. Animals from coastal sites always showed higher carbon values than animals from inland sites, at different ages and latitudes. The scientists believe nutrients from the ocean washed onto beaches and moved up the food chain, and seaweed was the most likely source.
研究團隊測量了牙釉質中的碳同位素。不論年代或緯度，海岸地區動物的碳數值都比內陸動物高。科學家認為，海洋的養分被沖上海灘，再沿著食物鏈往上傳遞，而海藻是最可能的來源。

One plant-eating dinosaur, Tenontosaurus, did not show this pattern, so it probably did not eat marine food. Lead author Clayton Forster, a geologist at the University of Arkansas, said the study shows the connections between land and sea ecosystems. It is the first evidence of this kind of food link in prehistoric ecosystems.
不過，草食性恐龍腱龍（Tenontosaurus）沒有出現這種模式，所以牠大概沒有吃海洋食物。第一作者、阿肯色大學地質學家福斯特（Clayton Forster）說，這項研究顯示了陸地和海洋生態系之間的連結。這是史前生態系中第一次發現這類食物連結的證據。
words: 複數 fossils｜fossil fuel 化石燃料｜v. fossilize 使變成化石

analysis.note: living near the coast 是現在分詞片語，等於 that lived near the coast。may have eaten 是 may have + p.p.，表示對過去的推測「可能曾經…」。新聞常把 a new study suggests 放在句尾，意思等於 A new study suggests that…。

items.title: Luka Doncic Scores 43 as Lakers Win Eighth Straight Game
items.titleZh: 唐西奇轟 43 分 湖人擊敗太陽豪取八連勝
items.teaser: 湖人一度領先 31 分，太陽第四節狂追仍差一截！唐西奇拿下本季第 6 場 40 分以上，湖人戰績來到 12 勝 2 敗。
paras: Luka Doncic scored 43 points as the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Phoenix Suns 131-123 on Sunday. It was the Lakers' eighth win in a row, and they improved to 12-2. Doncic, the NBA's leading scorer, made five 3-pointers and 12 of his 14 free throws. It was his sixth 40-point game this season.
唐西奇（Luka Doncic）週日攻下 43 分，帶領洛杉磯湖人以 131 比 123 擊敗鳳凰城太陽。這是湖人的八連勝，戰績提升到 12 勝 2 敗。身為聯盟得分王的唐西奇投進 5 記三分球，罰球 14 罰 12 中。這是他本季第 6 場得分 40 分以上的比賽。

Doncic had 25 points by halftime, and the Lakers led 64-54 at the break. They kept attacking after halftime and led by 31 points late in the third quarter. Quentin Grimes added 22 points and made five of his six 3-point shots. The Lakers played without Austin Reaves, who has a bruised heel.
唐西奇上半場就拿下 25 分，湖人中場以 64 比 54 領先。下半場湖人持續進攻，第三節尾聲一度領先 31 分。格萊姆斯（Quentin Grimes）貢獻 22 分，三分球 6 投 5 中。湖人這場少了腳跟挫傷的里夫斯（Austin Reaves）。

Phoenix fought back in the fourth quarter behind Collin Gillespie, who scored 26 points, including 12 in the final period. His layup cut the lead to 126-121 with 1:05 left, but the Suns got no closer. Devin Booker had 17 points on 4-of-14 shooting, and Phoenix fell to 5-7.
太陽在第四節靠著吉萊斯皮（Collin Gillespie）展開反撲，他全場拿下 26 分，其中 12 分在最後一節。他的上籃在比賽剩 1 分 05 秒時把比分追到 121 比 126，但太陽沒能再更接近。布克（Devin Booker）14 投 4 中拿 17 分，太陽戰績降到 5 勝 7 敗。

analysis.note: 主詞後面用兩個逗號夾住一個名詞片語，就是「同位語」，用來補充說明主詞的身分，等於 Doncic is the NBA's leading scorer。12 of his 14 free throws 是「14 次中的 12 次」，比賽報導常用這種 A of B 的寫法表示命中率。

items.title: Asian Chip Stocks Tumble After Nvidia CEO Exit
items.titleZh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳卸任 亞洲晶片股重挫、台股創史上第二大點數跌幅
items.teaser: 輝達宣布黃仁勳辭去執行長，週一台積電跌 5.7%、加權指數狂瀉 2,635 點，SK 海力士也跌近 8%。大家都在等輝達週二晚間公布財報。
paras: Shares of major Asian chipmakers fell sharply on Monday, November 16, as investors worried about the future of Nvidia, the world's leading AI chip designer. According to reports, Nvidia said on November 12 that Jensen Huang had resigned as CEO, and chief financial officer Colette Kress became interim chief.
亞洲主要晶片公司的股價在 11 月 16 日週一大幅下跌，因為投資人擔心 AI 晶片龍頭輝達（Nvidia）的未來。根據報導，輝達在 11 月 12 日表示黃仁勳已辭去執行長一職，由財務長克芮斯（Colette Kress）擔任代理執行長。

In Taiwan, shares of TSMC dropped about 5.7% to NT$2,215. The Taiex fell 6.03%, or 2,635 points, to 41,040.08, the second-largest point drop in the index's history. In South Korea, memory chipmaker SK Hynix lost 7.89%, while Samsung Electronics fell 4.47%.
在台灣，台積電股價下跌約 5.7%，收在新台幣 2,215 元。加權指數下跌 6.03%，也就是 2,635 點，收在 41,040.08 點，是指數史上第二大的點數跌幅。在南韓，記憶體大廠 SK 海力士下跌 7.89%，三星電子則跌 4.47%。

Investors are now waiting for Nvidia's third-quarter results, which are due on Tuesday, November 17, after the U.S. market closes. The company had earlier forecast revenue of about $108 billion. The results may show whether demand for AI chips is still strong after the change in leadership.
投資人現在正等待輝達的第三季財報，預定在 11 月 17 日週二美股收盤後公布。輝達先前預估營收約 1,080 億美元。這份財報可能會顯示，在領導階層更換之後，市場對 AI 晶片的需求是否依然強勁。

interim chief 代理執行長｜interim report 期中報告｜in the interim 在此期間
複數 investors｜v. invest 投資｜n. investment 投資
forecasts · forecast/forecasted · forecasting｜n. forecast 預測｜weather forecast 天氣預報

the second-largest point drop in the index's history.

quiz.ex: 第一段：chief financial officer Colette Kress became interim chief。黃仁勳是辭職的前執行長。

quiz.ex: 第二段：The Taiex fell 6.03%, or 2,635 points。5.7% 是台積電、7.89% 是 SK 海力士、4.47% 是三星。

items.title: Two Sides Debate Nuclear Power Ahead of Taiwan's Referendum
items.titleZh: 核電公投前辯論 擁核與反核代表各自表述
items.teaser: 11 月 28 日的公投要問大家是否恢復核電。中選會舉辦的辯論會上，擁核的黃士修和反核的沈佩玲各提出了哪些理由？
paras: Ahead of a referendum on restoring nuclear power, a supporter and an opponent of nuclear energy debated on Monday at a livestreamed forum organized by Taiwan's Central Election Commission. The referendum will be held on November 28, together with local elections.
在恢復核電的公投之前，一位擁核人士和一位反核人士週一在中央選舉委員會舉辦、全程直播的發表會上展開辯論。這次公投將在 11 月 28 日和地方選舉一起舉行。

Pro-nuclear activist Huang Shih-hsiu urged voters to support restoring nuclear power. He said the ruling Democratic Progressive Party's goal of a nuclear-free Taiwan had made the country rely too much on natural gas and thermal power, and that the party had failed to meet its renewable energy targets.
擁核人士黃士修呼籲選民支持恢復核電。他說，執政的民進黨追求「非核家園」，使台灣過度依賴天然氣和火力發電，而且民進黨也沒有達成再生能源的目標。

Shen Pei-ling, a spokeswoman for the Taiwan Obasang Political Equality Party, agreed that nuclear power has low emissions and a stable supply. However, she said the referendum offers no clear plans for nuclear waste or for how nuclear power would return, and that local communities had not been properly consulted. Taiwan shut down its last operating reactor, at Maanshan, in May 2025.
歐巴桑聯盟發言人沈佩玲同意核電排碳低、供電穩定。不過她說，這次公投沒有提出處理核廢料、或核電要怎麼重新上路的明確計畫，而且也沒有好好徵詢地方社區的意見。台灣最後一座運轉中的反應爐——核三廠（馬鞍山），已在 2025 年 5 月停機。
words: 複數 referendums / referenda｜hold a referendum 舉行公投｜vote in a referendum 參加公投
restores · restored · restoring｜n. restoration 恢復；修復
renewable energy 再生能源｜v. renew 更新；續約
複數 emissions｜carbon emissions 碳排放｜v. emit 排放
consults · consulted · consulting｜n. consultation 諮詢｜n. consultant 顧問

analysis.zh: 台灣最後一座運轉中的反應爐——核三廠（馬鞍山），已在 2025 年 5 月停機。
analysis.note: shut down 是「關閉；停止運轉」，三態都是 shut。operating 是現在分詞當形容詞，表示「正在運轉中的」。英文習慣先寫地點、再寫時間（at Maanshan, in May 2025）。

analysis.zh: 不過她說，這次公投沒有提出處理核廢料、或核電要怎麼重新上路的明確計畫，而且也沒有好好徵詢地方社區的意見。
parts: the referendum offers no clear plans for nuclear waste or for how nuclear power would return,
名詞子句（省略 that，當 said 的受詞）
and that local communities had not been properly consulted.
and that 引導的第二個名詞子句
analysis.note: said 後面接兩個名詞子句：第一個省略了 that，第二個因為前面有 and，必須寫出 that，讀者才知道它也是 said 的內容。had not been consulted 是「過去完成式＋被動」，表示在她說話之前就「沒有被徵詢」。for how… 是介系詞後面接 how 引導的名詞子句。

quiz.ex: 第一段：The referendum will be held on November 28, together with local elections。和地方選舉同一天，不是之後。

quiz.q: What did Huang Shih-hsiu argue?
opts: Taiwan relies too much on natural gas and thermal power.
Nuclear waste plans are not clear.
Taiwan should build more gas power plants.
quiz.ex: 第二段：黃士修說非核家園政策讓台灣 rely too much on natural gas and thermal power。B、C 是沈佩玲的看法。

quiz.q: Which point did Shen Pei-ling AGREE with?
opts: Nuclear power has low emissions and a stable supply.
The DPP met its renewable energy targets.
quiz.ex: 第三段：Shen…agreed that nuclear power has low emissions and a stable supply，但她仍認為公投缺乏具體計畫。

items.title: Emergency Blanket Material Could Protect Future Moon Bases
items.titleZh: 急救毯的材料 有望成為月球基地的隔熱層
items.teaser: 月球溫差從零下幾百度到沸騰都有！賓州大學把急救毯用的超薄塑膠疊上幾百層，做成又耐壓又隔熱的材料，連呼吸都會把它吹飛。
paras: Engineers at the University of Pennsylvania have turned Mylar, the thin plastic used in emergency blankets, into a strong insulation material that could help people live on the Moon. Temperatures on the Moon can swing from hundreds of degrees below zero to boiling hot, so bases and spacesuits need good protection.
賓州大學的工程師把急救毯使用的薄塑膠「聚酯薄膜」（Mylar），變成一種堅固的隔熱材料，未來可能幫助人類在月球上生活。月球的溫度可以從零下幾百度變化到滾燙，所以基地和太空衣都需要良好的保護。

The team stacked hundreds of extremely thin Mylar sheets, and some were coated with a very thin layer of aluminum oxide. The layers are so light that, as first author Danielle Levin said, even breathing near them can send them flying. Yet the stacks survived being pressed at about 20 megapascals 10 times in a row.
研究團隊把數百張極薄的聚酯薄膜疊在一起，其中一些還鍍上一層非常薄的氧化鋁。這些薄膜輕到像第一作者李文（Danielle Levin）說的，連在旁邊呼吸都可能把它們吹飛。然而這些薄膜堆疊被以約 20 百萬帕的壓力連續壓了 10 次，仍然完好無損。

Senior author Igor Bargatin said the ideal material must resist both damage and heat loss, because astronauts will inevitably bump into things. The researchers say the material could be used in lunar habitats, spacesuits and rovers. Their study was published in the journal ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces.
資深作者巴加汀（Igor Bargatin）說，理想的材料必須同時能抵抗損壞和熱量流失，因為太空人難免會撞到東西。研究人員表示，這種材料可以用在月球居住艙、太空衣和探測車上。這項研究發表在期刊《ACS 應用材料與介面》。
words: v. insulate（insulates · insulated · insulating）｜heat insulation 隔熱
stacks · stacked · stacking｜n. stack 一疊；一堆｜a stack of books 一疊書
coats · coated · coating｜n. coating 塗層｜n. coat 外套
adj. inevitable 不可避免的｜n. inevitability
複數 habitats｜natural habitat 自然棲地｜lunar habitat 月球居住艙

analysis.zh: 賓州大學的工程師把急救毯使用的薄塑膠變成一種堅固的隔熱材料，未來可能幫助人類在月球上生活。
parts: 修飾主詞（哪裡的工程師）
the thin plastic used in emergency blankets,
同位語（說明 Mylar 是什麼）
turn A into B 的 B
that could help people live on the Moon.
analysis.note: turn A into B 是「把 A 變成 B」，中間的 A 很長，因為插了一個同位語。同位語裡的 used in emergency blankets 是過去分詞片語，等於 which is used in…。最後 that 引導關係子句修飾 material；help＋人＋原形動詞（help people live）。

analysis.zh: 這些薄膜輕到像第一作者李文說的，連在旁邊呼吸都可能把它們吹飛。
parts: as first author Danielle Levin said,
插入的 as 子句（正如…所說）
analysis.note: so＋形容詞＋that…表示「太…以至於…」。that 後面插入 as 子句，as 在這裡是「正如」。結果子句的主詞是動名詞片語 breathing near them；send＋受詞＋V-ing 表示「使…（猛然）做某動作」，send them flying 就是「把它們吹飛」。

quiz.q: What is Mylar usually used for?
quiz.ex: 第一段：Mylar, the thin plastic used in emergency blankets。月球太空衣是未來可能的用途。

quiz.q: How did the stacks perform in the pressure test?
opts: They survived 10 tests in a row.
quiz.ex: 第二段：the stacks survived being pressed at about 20 megapascals 10 times in a row。

quiz.q: Why must the material resist damage, according to Bargatin?
opts: It is very expensive to make.
Astronauts will inevitably bump into things.
quiz.ex: 第三段：because astronauts will inevitably bump into things。呼吸會把薄膜吹飛，是講操作實驗時的小困難，不是損壞的原因。

source.title: ScienceDaily（Penn Engineering）：The secret to building Moon bases may be hiding in emergency blankets（2026/11/15）

items.title: Heat Beat Rockets 128-110 for Fifth Straight Win
items.titleZh: 熱火 128 比 110 擊敗火箭 拿下五連勝
items.teaser: 熱火全場沒有落後過，字母哥 20 分 13 籃板，湯普森投進 5 記三分！開季 0 勝 4 敗的熱火，之後打出 8 勝 2 敗。
paras: The Miami Heat beat the Houston Rockets 128-110 on Monday night for their fifth straight win. Miami never trailed in the game, and the Heat are now 8-6. They have gone 8-2 since starting the season 0-4.
邁阿密熱火週一晚上以 128 比 110 擊敗休士頓火箭，拿下五連勝。熱火整場比賽從未落後，戰績來到 8 勝 6 敗。他們開季 0 勝 4 敗，之後打出 8 勝 2 敗。

Giannis Antetokounmpo led Miami with 20 points, 13 rebounds and six assists. Klay Thompson added 17 points with five 3-pointers, and Andrew Wiggins also scored 17. Davion Mitchell had 16 points and 10 assists. Houston missed eight of its first nine shots and scored only two points in the first 5:54.
字母哥（Giannis Antetokounmpo）以 20 分、13 籃板、6 助攻帶領熱火。湯普森（Klay Thompson）投進 5 記三分球、貢獻 17 分，威金斯（Andrew Wiggins）也拿下 17 分，米契爾（Davion Mitchell）則有 16 分、10 助攻。火箭開賽前 9 次出手只進 1 球，開賽 5 分 54 秒只得到 2 分。

Alperen Sengun scored 23 points and Kevin Durant had 22 for the Rockets, who had won four games in a row. It was Houston's first loss in six games against Eastern Conference teams this season. Miami's Bam Adebayo missed the second half with right hip tightness.
火箭這邊，申京（Alperen Sengun）拿下 23 分，杜蘭特（Kevin Durant）得到 22 分；火箭賽前已經四連勝。這是火箭本季對東區球隊六場比賽中的第一場敗仗。熱火的阿德巴約（Bam Adebayo）因為右髖緊繃，下半場沒有上場。
words: 比較級 straighter · straightest｜adv. straight 直接地｜five straight wins 五連勝
trails · trailed · trailing｜n. trail 小徑；痕跡｜trail by 10 points 落後 10 分
複數 rebounds｜v. rebound 反彈（rebounds · rebounded · rebounding）
複數 assists｜v. assist 協助（assists · assisted · assisting）｜n. assistant 助理
不可數｜adj. tight 緊的（tighter · tightest）｜v. tighten 使變緊

analysis.zh: 字母哥以 20 分、13 籃板、6 助攻帶領熱火。
parts: with 20 points, 13 rebounds and six assists.
修飾（with 片語說明靠什麼帶領）
analysis.note: lead 的三態是 lead · led · led，led 讀作 /led/。lead + 球隊 + with + 數據，是比賽報導最常見的句型，意思是「以…的成績帶領某隊」。列舉三個以上的項目時，最後一項前面加 and。

analysis.zh: 火箭這邊，申京拿下 23 分，杜蘭特得到 22 分；火箭賽前已經四連勝。

who had won four games in a row.
非限定關係子句（補充說明 the Rockets）
analysis.note: 逗號後面的 who… 是「非限定關係子句」，只是補充說明火箭隊，拿掉也不影響句意。had won 是過去完成式，表示在這場比賽「之前」已經完成的事（已經連贏四場）。had 22 省略了重複的 points，讓句子更精簡。

quiz.ex: 第一段：for their fifth straight win，熱火拿下五連勝。4 是火箭先前的連勝場數，8 是熱火的勝場數。

quiz.q: Who scored the most points for Houston?
quiz.ex: 第三段：Alperen Sengun scored 23 points，比杜蘭特的 22 分多。湯普森和威金斯是熱火球員。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The Heat trailed early in the game.
Bam Adebayo played the whole game.

quiz.ex: 第二段：scored only two points in the first 5:54。熱火從未落後；阿德巴約下半場沒上場；火箭本季對東區原本是全勝，這是第一敗。

items.title: Nvidia's Sales More Than Double in First Report Under Interim CEO
items.titleZh: 輝達代理執行長上任後首份財報 營收年增 103%
items.teaser: 黃仁勳卸任後，輝達交出第一份成績單：單季營收 1,158 億美元，資料中心年增 110%，下一季預估約 1,300 億美元。
paras: Nvidia reported revenue of $115.8 billion for its third quarter on Tuesday, November 17. That was up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago. It was the company's first earnings report since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO.
輝達（Nvidia）在 11 月 17 日週二公布第三季營收為 1,158 億美元，比上一季成長 20%，比去年同期成長 103%。這是黃仁勳辭去執行長之後，公司公布的第一份財報。

Most of the money came from data centers, the huge facilities that run AI models. Data center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year earlier. The company's gross margin, which shows how much of each dollar of sales is left after production costs, was 74.8%.
大部分的收入來自資料中心，也就是運行 AI 模型的大型設施。資料中心營收達到 1,076 億美元，比去年同期成長 110%。代表每一塊錢營收扣掉生產成本後還剩多少的毛利率，為 74.8%。

Colette Kress, the interim CEO, said the company's momentum is real and that its new Vera Rubin platform is off to an explosive start. Nvidia expects fourth-quarter revenue of about $130 billion, an estimate that does not include data center chip sales to China.
代理執行長克芮斯（Colette Kress）表示，公司的成長動能是真實的，新一代 Vera Rubin 平台也有爆發性的開局。輝達預估第四季營收約 1,300 億美元，這個預估沒有把賣給中國的資料中心晶片算進去。
words: 複數 revenues｜quarterly revenue 季營收｜tax revenue 稅收
複數 facilities｜v. facilitate 促進｜a production facility 生產廠房
複數 margins｜gross margin 毛利率｜by a wide margin 大幅領先
無比較級｜n. in the interim 在此期間｜an interim CEO 代理執行長
不可數｜gain momentum 氣勢增強｜lose momentum 失去動能

analysis.zh: 代表每一塊錢營收扣掉生產成本後還剩多少的毛利率，為 74.8%。
parts: which shows how much of each dollar of sales is left after production costs,
非限定關係子句（解釋什麼是毛利率）
analysis.note: 主詞和動詞中間插入一個用逗號夾住的 which 子句，補充說明 gross margin 的意思；讀的時候先跳過它，就能看出主幹是 The company's gross margin was 74.8%。子句裡的 how much … is left 是名詞子句，當 shows 的受詞，要用直述句語序（is 放在後面）。

analysis.zh: 輝達預估第四季營收約 1,300 億美元，這個預估沒有把賣給中國的資料中心晶片算進去。

同位語（說明前面那個數字是預估值，內含 that 關係子句）
analysis.note: 逗號後面的 an estimate… 是同位語，把前面整個受詞「換個說法」再補充說明。財經新聞很常用這種寫法，先講數字，再用名詞片語補充性質。fourth-quarter 加連字號當形容詞修飾 revenue。

quiz.q: How much did Nvidia's quarterly revenue grow from a year ago?
quiz.ex: 第一段：up 103% from a year ago。20% 是比上一季的成長，110% 是資料中心的年成長，74.8% 是毛利率。

quiz.q: Where did most of Nvidia's revenue come from?
quiz.ex: 第二段：Most of the money came from data centers。中國的資料中心晶片銷售反而沒有算進下一季的預估。

quiz.q: What does the passage say about the $130 billion figure?
opts: It was the revenue for the third quarter.
It includes chip sales to China.
It is the company's forecast for the fourth quarter.
It is the value of the Vera Rubin platform.
quiz.ex: 第三段：Nvidia expects fourth-quarter revenue of about $130 billion，是第四季的預估，而且 does not include … sales to China。

items.title: Taoyuan Mayor Candidates Focus on Bus Problems
items.titleZh: 桃園市長政見發表會 張善政、黃世杰聚焦公車問題
items.teaser: 11 月 28 日地方選舉前，桃園市長候選人在電視政見發表會上各自提出公車改善方案。民進黨的黃世杰和國民黨的張善政怎麼說？
paras: The two candidates for mayor of Taoyuan presented their policies at a televised event organized by the city's election commission, ahead of local elections on November 28. Incumbent mayor Chang San-cheng of the Kuomintang (KMT) is seeking a second term. He faces Huang Shih-chieh of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), a former legislator.
桃園市長的兩位候選人在市選委會舉辦、電視轉播的政見發表會上提出政見，地方選舉將在 11 月 28 日舉行。國民黨籍的現任市長張善政尋求連任，對手是民進黨籍、曾任立法委員的黃世杰。

Bus services were a major topic. Huang said many buses are 'ghost buses' whose arrival information does not match reality, and he promised a new three-level bus network. 'People should be able to wait for a bus, see it and get on it,' he said.
公車服務是主要議題之一。黃世杰說，很多公車是到站資訊和實際狀況對不上的「幽靈公車」，並承諾建立新的三層公車路網。他說：「民眾應該要能等到公車、看到公車、搭上公車。」

Chang admitted that many residents are unhappy with bus services. He blamed a lack of competition among a few local bus companies and a nationwide shortage of drivers. He said his government raised drivers' monthly allowances from NT$6,000 to NT$10,000 and helped replace nearly 300 old buses.
張善政承認很多市民不滿意公車服務。他把問題歸因於少數地方客運業者缺乏競爭，以及全國性的司機荒。他說市府已把司機每月津貼從新台幣 6,000 元提高到 1 萬元，並協助汰換將近 300 輛老舊公車。
words: 複數 candidates｜n. candidacy 候選資格｜a mayoral candidate 市長候選人
n. incumbent 現任者（複數 incumbents）｜the incumbent mayor 現任市長
複數 realities｜adj. real 真實的｜in reality 實際上
複數 shortages｜adj. short 短缺的｜a shortage of drivers 司機短缺
複數 allowances｜v. allow 允許｜a monthly allowance 每月津貼

analysis.zh: 黃世杰說，很多公車是到站資訊和實際狀況對不上的「幽靈公車」，並承諾建立新的三層公車路網。
parts: 名詞子句當受詞（省略 that）
whose arrival information does not match reality,
whose 關係子句（修飾 ghost buses）
and he promised a new three-level bus network.
analysis.note: said 後面的名詞子句省略了 that，口語和新聞都很常見。whose 是「所有格關係代名詞」，whose arrival information = the ghost buses' arrival information，用來說明是什麼樣的公車。three-level 加連字號變成形容詞，修飾 bus network。

analysis.zh: 他說市府已把司機每月津貼從新台幣 6,000 元提高到 1 萬元，並協助汰換將近 300 輛老舊公車。
parts: his government raised drivers' monthly allowances
名詞子句當受詞（省略 that）
修飾（from A to B 表示變化）
and helped replace nearly 300 old buses.
and 連接的第二個動詞片語
analysis.note: raise … from A to B 表示「把…從 A 提高到 B」。helped replace 是 help + 原形動詞，help 後面可以直接接原形動詞，也可以接 to V（helped to replace），意思一樣。drivers' 是複數名詞的所有格，撇號放在 s 後面。

quiz.q: Who is the current mayor of Taoyuan?
opts: A former legislator from the DPP
No one; the seat is empty
quiz.ex: 第一段：Incumbent mayor Chang San-cheng of the Kuomintang，incumbent 就是「現任的」。黃世杰是民進黨籍、曾任立委的挑戰者。

quiz.q: What does Huang mean by 'ghost buses'?
opts: Buses that run only at night
Buses whose arrival information does not match reality
quiz.ex: 第二段：'ghost buses' whose arrival information does not match reality，指到站資訊和實際狀況對不上的公車。

quiz.q: According to Chang, what is one cause of the bus problems?
quiz.ex: 第三段：He blamed … a nationwide shortage of drivers。他說的是少數業者「缺乏競爭」，不是競爭太多；三層路網是黃世杰的提案。

source.title: Focus Taiwan（CNA）：Candidates address Taoyuan's bus woes at TV policy presentation（2026/11/17）

items.title: Tiny Animals Found Living Inside Deep-Sea Rocks
items.titleZh: 深海石頭裡藏著小動物 一顆住了 245 隻
items.teaser: 太平洋 4,000 多公尺深的海底，拳頭大的「多金屬結核」裂縫裡竟住著上千隻小動物！但這些石頭也是採礦公司想要的寶藏。
paras: Scientists in Germany have found a hidden world of tiny animals living inside rocks on the deep seafloor. The rocks, called polymetallic nodules, are about the size of a fist and lie 4,000 to 6,000 meters below the surface of the Pacific Ocean. They grow only a few millimeters every million years.
德國科學家在深海海底的石頭裡，發現了一個住滿小動物的隱藏世界。這些石頭叫做「多金屬結核」，大約拳頭大小，位在太平洋海面下 4,000 到 6,000 公尺深的地方。它們每一百萬年只長大幾公釐。

Researchers from MARUM at the University of Bremen opened 244 nodules and found 4,139 animals in their cracks. Most were smaller than a millimeter, including roundworms and tiny crustaceans. On average, each nodule held 17 animals, and the busiest one was home to 245.
不來梅大學 MARUM 海洋環境科學中心的研究人員剖開 244 顆結核，在裂縫裡找到 4,139 隻動物。牠們大多不到 1 公釐，包括線蟲和微小的甲殼類動物。平均每顆結核住了 17 隻，最熱鬧的一顆住了 245 隻。

The nodules contain valuable metals such as nickel, cobalt and copper, so some companies want to mine them. The scientists warn that mining could cause an irreversible loss of unique animals, because new nodules would take millions of years to form.
這些結核含有鎳、鈷、銅等珍貴金屬，所以有些公司想開採它們。科學家警告，採礦可能造成獨特動物無法挽回的消失，因為新的結核要花好幾百萬年才能形成。
words: 複數 cracks｜v. crack 使破裂（cracks · cracked · cracking）｜crack a joke 說笑話
複數 crustaceans｜例如螃蟹 crab、蝦 shrimp、龍蝦 lobster
more valuable · most valuable｜n. value 價值｜n. valuables 貴重物品
mines · mined · mining｜n. mine 礦坑｜n. mining 採礦（業）｜n. miner 礦工
反義 reversible 可逆的｜v. reverse 反轉｜adv. irreversibly

analysis.zh: 這些石頭叫做「多金屬結核」，大約拳頭大小，位在太平洋海面下 4,000 到 6,000 公尺深的地方。
parts: 過去分詞片語（= which are called…）
about the size of a fist
and lie 4,000 to 6,000 meters below the surface of the Pacific Ocean.
and 連接的第二個動詞片語（lie 位於）
analysis.note: called polymetallic nodules 是「過去分詞片語」，由 which are called… 省略而來，用來補充石頭的名稱。這裡的 lie 是「位於」（lie · lay · lain），不要和 lie「說謊」（lie · lied · lied）搞混。the size of a fist 用「the size of + 東西」表示「…那麼大」。

analysis.zh: 科學家警告，採礦可能造成獨特動物無法挽回的消失，因為新的結核要花好幾百萬年才能形成。
parts: that mining could cause an irreversible loss of unique animals,
because new nodules would take millions of years to form.
because 副詞子句（說明原因）
analysis.note: warn that… 表示「警告說…」，that 子句裡的 mining 是動名詞當主詞。could 和 would 都在表達「可能的結果」，是一種推測的語氣。take + 時間 + to V 表示「花多少時間才能…」，例如 It takes ten minutes to walk there。

quiz.q: How big are the polymetallic nodules?
opts: About the size of a fist
quiz.ex: 第一段：are about the size of a fist。小於 1 公釐的是住在裡面的動物。

quiz.q: How many animals did the busiest nodule hold?
quiz.ex: 第二段：the busiest one was home to 245。17 是平均數，244 是剖開的結核數，4,139 是動物總數。

quiz.q: Why do the scientists worry about mining?
opts: The nodules would take millions of years to form again.
The animals are dangerous to miners.
quiz.ex: 第三段：because new nodules would take millions of years to form，結核被挖走後短時間內不會再長出來，損失無法挽回。

source.title: ScienceDaily（MARUM）：Hidden ecosystem: Scientists discover 245 animals living inside a single deep-sea rock（2026/11/16）

items.title: Quentin Grimes Scores 47 as Lakers Beat Hornets in Overtime
items.titleZh: 葛萊姆斯狂砍 47 分 湖人延長賽逆轉黃蜂
items.teaser: 葛萊姆斯投進 10 記三分，最後 1.7 秒追平逼進延長賽！湖人下半場曾落後 18 分，最後 118 比 114 逆轉，拿下九連勝。
paras: Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points as the Los Angeles Lakers came back to beat the Charlotte Hornets 118-114 in overtime on Tuesday night. The Lakers had trailed by 18 points in the second half. It was their ninth straight win, and they are now 13-2.
週二晚上，葛萊姆斯（Quentin Grimes）攻下生涯新高 47 分，帶領洛杉磯湖人在延長賽以 118 比 114 逆轉夏洛特黃蜂。湖人下半場一度落後 18 分。這是他們的九連勝，戰績來到 13 勝 2 敗。

Grimes made 10 3-pointers and scored 21 points in the fourth quarter. Charlotte led 110-106 with 20 seconds left, but Luka Doncic found Grimes, who hit his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds remaining to force overtime. Grimes joined Kobe Bryant as the only Lakers players to make 10 3-pointers in a game.
葛萊姆斯投進 10 記三分球，光第四節就拿下 21 分。黃蜂在剩 20 秒時以 110 比 106 領先，但東契奇（Luka Doncic）傳球給葛萊姆斯，他在剩 1.7 秒時投進自己的第 10 記三分，把比賽逼進延長賽。葛萊姆斯和柯比（Kobe Bryant）成為湖人隊史僅有的兩位單場投進 10 記三分的球員。

Doncic added 36 points and seven assists. In overtime, Grimes forced a turnover with 17.4 seconds left and made two free throws to seal the win. Brandon Miller and Naz Reid each scored 28 points for Charlotte, which has lost nine of its last 10 games.
東契奇貢獻 36 分、7 助攻。延長賽剩 17.4 秒時，葛萊姆斯逼出對手失誤，再罰進兩球鎖定勝利。黃蜂的米勒（Brandon Miller）和瑞德（Naz Reid）各拿 28 分；黃蜂最近 10 場比賽輸了 9 場。
words: 不可數｜adv. overtime 加班地｜work overtime 加班｜go into overtime 進入延長賽
n. career high 生涯新高｜a career-high 47 points 生涯新高的 47 分
forces · forced · forcing｜n. force 力量；武力｜force overtime 逼進延長賽
複數 turnovers｜force a turnover 逼出失誤｜staff turnover 員工流動率
seals · sealed · sealing｜n. seal 印章；海豹｜seal the win 鎖定勝利

analysis.zh: 黃蜂在剩 20 秒時以 110 比 106 領先，但東契奇傳球給葛萊姆斯，他在剩 1.7 秒時投進第 10 記三分，把比賽逼進延長賽。
parts: 非限定關係子句（補充說明 Grimes）
修飾（with + 名詞 + V-ing 表示當時的狀況）
不定詞表結果（逼進延長賽）
analysis.note: with 20 seconds left 和 with 1.7 seconds remaining 都是「with + 名詞 + 分詞」，用來說明「在剩下多少時間的情況下」，left 是過去分詞、remaining 是現在分詞，意思一樣。逗號後的 who… 是非限定關係子句，補充說明葛萊姆斯做了什麼。

analysis.zh: 延長賽剩 17.4 秒時，葛萊姆斯逼出對手失誤，再罰進兩球鎖定勝利。
parts: 動詞 2（and 連接同一個主詞的第二個動作）
analysis.note: 同一個主詞做了兩件事時，可以用 and 連接兩個動詞（forced … and made …），不必重複主詞。句尾 to seal the win 是不定詞，說明這兩球的作用是「鎖定勝利」。

quiz.q: How many points did Quentin Grimes score?
quiz.ex: 第一段：scored a career-high 47 points。36 分是東契奇，28 分是米勒和瑞德，118 是湖人總得分。

quiz.q: How did the game go into overtime?
opts: Grimes hit a 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left.
Charlotte missed a shot at the buzzer.
quiz.ex: 第二段：Grimes hit his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds remaining to force overtime，是葛萊姆斯的三分球把比賽逼進延長賽。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The Lakers led by 18 points in the second half.
The Lakers have lost two games this season.
Charlotte has won nine of its last 10 games.
quiz.ex: 第一段：they are now 13-2，湖人只輸兩場。湖人下半場是「落後」18 分；黃蜂是最近 10 場輸 9 場；47 分是葛萊姆斯。

items.title: Samsung and TSMC Shares Fall After New U.S. Chip Curbs on China
items.titleZh: 美國加強限制中國取得 AI 晶片 三星、台積電股價下跌
items.teaser: 美國新規：先進 AI 晶片賣到新加坡、馬來西亞等五國要申請許可，晶圓代工廠替中國客戶代工也要多一層審查，三星、台積電股價應聲下跌近 5%。
paras: Shares of Samsung Electronics and TSMC fell nearly 5% in Asian trading on November 17. The drop came after the United States announced new rules to further limit China's access to advanced AI chips. Other chip-related stocks in the region also fell.
11 月 17 日，三星電子和台積電的股價在亞洲交易時段下跌將近 5%。下跌的原因是美國宣布新規定，要進一步限制中國取得先進 AI 晶片。區域內其他和晶片相關的股票也跟著下跌。

Under the new rules, shipments of advanced AI chips to data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil will require U.S. export licenses. Washington sees these countries as places where chips are at higher risk of being sent to China. The rules also add checks on overseas data centers that rent large amounts of computing power to Chinese companies.
根據新規定，先進 AI 晶片要運到新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼和巴西的資料中心，都必須取得美國的出口許可。美國政府認為，晶片在這些國家被轉送到中國的風險較高。新規定也加強審查那些把大量運算能力出租給中國公司的海外資料中心。

Foundries that make advanced chips for Chinese fabless companies will also face tighter requirements. An analyst at CLSA said Samsung's foundry business might need extra customer checks and licenses. Such measures could raise compliance costs and cause delays for companies with Chinese customers.
替中國「無晶圓廠」晶片設計公司生產先進晶片的晶圓代工廠，也將面臨更嚴格的要求。里昂證券（CLSA）一位分析師表示，三星的晶圓代工業務可能需要額外的客戶審查和許可。這些措施可能提高法規遵循的成本，也會讓有中國客戶的公司遇到延誤。
words: 複數 foundries｜foundry business 晶圓代工業務
無晶圓廠的（只設計晶片、委外生產）
fab（晶圓廠）+ -less（沒有）｜a fabless chip company 無晶圓廠晶片公司
複數 licenses｜v. license 核發許可（licenses · licensed · licensing）｜export license 出口許可
不可數｜v. comply (with) 遵守｜adj. compliant 合規的｜compliance costs 合規成本
複數 shipments｜v. ship 運送（ships · shipped · shipping）

analysis.zh: 根據新規定，先進 AI 晶片要運到新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼和巴西的資料中心，都必須取得美國的出口許可。
parts: shipments of advanced AI chips to data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil
主詞（核心是 shipments，後面的 of…、to…、in… 都是修飾）
analysis.note: 這句的主詞很長，但真正的主詞只有 shipments（出貨），後面接了三個介系詞片語：of（什麼貨）、to（運到哪）、in（在哪些國家）。讀長句時先找到核心名詞和動詞 will require，句子就清楚了。

analysis.zh: 替中國無晶圓廠公司生產先進晶片的晶圓代工廠，也將面臨更嚴格的要求。
parts: that make advanced chips for Chinese fabless companies
限定關係子句（說明是哪些代工廠）
analysis.note: that make… 是限定關係子句，用來限定「哪些」代工廠，不能拿掉，所以前面沒有逗號。關係子句的動詞 make 要和先行詞 Foundries（複數）一致。tighter 是 tight 的比較級，tight requirements 指「嚴格的規定」。

quiz.q: Why did Samsung and TSMC shares fall?
opts: The U.S. announced new limits on China's access to AI chips.
quiz.ex: 第一段：The drop came after the United States announced new rules to further limit China's access to advanced AI chips。

quiz.q: Which country is NOT named in the new license rule?
quiz.ex: 第二段列出的五國是 Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil，沒有日本。

quiz.q: What might the new rules mean for companies with Chinese customers?
quiz.ex: 第三段：Such measures could raise compliance costs and cause delays for companies with Chinese customers。

items.title: President Lai Urges Opposition to Drop NT$20,000 Cash Handout Bill
items.titleZh: 賴總統呼籲在野黨別推全民發 2 萬元現金法案
items.teaser: 行政院原本規劃每人發 1 萬元，國民黨提案加碼到 2 萬元，立法院最快週五表決。國民黨說今年稅收超乎預期、有空間；賴清德則說會破壞財政平衡。
paras: President Lai Ching-te on Wednesday urged opposition parties not to pass a bill that would give every member of the public a cash handout of NT$20,000. The opposition-controlled Legislature could reportedly vote on the bill as early as Friday.
賴清德總統週三呼籲在野黨，不要通過一項全民每人發放 2 萬元現金的法案。據報導，在野黨占多數的立法院最快週五就可能表決這項法案。

In August, the Cabinet proposed giving each person NT$10,000 in its 2027 budget, setting aside NT$235.7 billion for the plan. The Kuomintang (KMT) wants to double the amount through a special budget, arguing that higher-than-expected tax revenue this year, driven largely by the AI boom, leaves enough room. In mid-October, the Taiwan People's Party (TPP) voted to send the bill straight to a second reading without committee review.
行政院在 8 月提出的 2027 年度預算中，規劃全民每人發放 1 萬元，為此編列 2,357 億元。國民黨則希望透過特別預算把金額加倍，理由是今年稅收高於預期、主要受到 AI 熱潮帶動，財政有足夠空間。民眾黨在 10 月中旬投票，讓這項法案不經委員會審查、直接進入二讀。

According to a Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) spokesperson, Lai said the bill would hurt fiscal balance, take money away from other priorities and increase government debt for future generations. He also said it would encroach on the Cabinet's authority over the budget.
根據民進黨發言人轉述，賴清德表示，這項法案會破壞財政平衡、排擠其他優先項目的經費，並增加政府債務、留給後代承擔。他也說，這項法案侵犯了行政院在預算上的權限。
words: 複數 handouts｜v. hand out 分發｜a cash handout 現金發放
常用複數 revenues｜tax revenue 稅收｜sales revenue 營業收入
adv. fiscally｜fiscal balance 財政平衡｜fiscal year 會計年度
複數 priorities｜v. prioritize 優先處理｜top priority 第一優先
encroaches · encroached · encroaching｜n. encroachment 侵犯｜encroach on/upon 侵犯…

analysis.zh: 國民黨希望透過特別預算把金額加倍，理由是今年稅收高於預期、主要受到 AI 熱潮帶動，財政有足夠空間。
parts: arguing that higher-than-expected tax revenue this year, driven largely by the AI boom, leaves enough room.
分詞構句（arguing 說明理由，後接 that 子句）
analysis.note: arguing… 是分詞構句，等於 and it argues that…，用來補充主詞的理由。that 子句裡，driven largely by the AI boom 是過去分詞片語，插在中間補充說明稅收「受到什麼帶動」；子句真正的主詞是 tax revenue，動詞是 leaves。higher-than-expected 用連字號組成形容詞，意思是「高於預期的」。

analysis.zh: 賴清德總統週三呼籲在野黨，不要通過一項全民每人發放 2 萬元現金的法案。
parts: 受詞補語（urge + 人 + not to V）
that would give every member of the public a cash handout of NT$20,000.
關係子句（修飾 a bill；give + 人 + 物）
analysis.note: urge someone (not) to do something 是「呼籲某人（不要）做某事」，否定時 not 放在 to 前面。that would give… 是關係子句，說明是什麼法案；would 表示法案「若通過將會」怎樣。give + 人 + 物 是雙受詞句型：give every member of the public（給誰）a cash handout（給什麼）。

quiz.q: How much cash per person did the Cabinet first propose?
quiz.ex: 第二段：the Cabinet proposed giving each person NT$10,000。2 萬元是國民黨版本，2,357 億元是整個計畫編列的金額。

quiz.q: What reason does the KMT give for doubling the amount?
opts: Tax revenue was higher than expected.
quiz.ex: 第二段：arguing that higher-than-expected tax revenue this year … leaves enough room，國民黨認為稅收高於預期，財政有空間。

quiz.q: Which of these did Lai NOT say about the bill?
opts: It would encroach on the Cabinet's authority.
It would raise taxes next year.
quiz.ex: 第三段提到財政平衡、排擠其他優先項目、增加債務、侵犯行政院權限，沒有說會在明年加稅。

items.title: Tiny Space Dust Points to Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune
items.titleZh: 小小太空塵埃 揭露海王星外的遠古冰
items.teaser: NASA 用高空飛機在平流層收集了 12 顆微小塵埃，一路追查出它們來自古柏帶，還找到遠古的水留下的痕跡。
paras: NASA scientists have found strong evidence of an ancient store of ice in the Kuiper Belt, a distant region of the solar system beyond Neptune. Surprisingly, the clues came from tiny grains of space dust collected high in Earth's own atmosphere.
NASA 科學家找到有力證據，顯示古柏帶——太陽系裡位於海王星外的遙遠區域——存在一座遠古的冰庫。令人意外的是，線索來自在地球自己大氣層高處收集到的微小太空塵埃顆粒。

The team studied 12 dust particles collected from the stratosphere by NASA's ER-2 high-altitude research aircraft. Working with colleagues at UCLA, they used electron microscopes and an ion microprobe to examine the particles' minerals and oxygen isotopes. Large numbers of tracks left by energetic particles from the Sun helped show that the dust came from the Kuiper Belt.
研究團隊分析了 NASA 的 ER-2 高空研究機從平流層收集到的 12 顆塵埃粒子。他們和加州大學洛杉磯分校（UCLA）的同事合作，用電子顯微鏡和離子微探針檢查這些粒子的礦物與氧同位素。粒子上有大量太陽高能粒子留下的痕跡，幫助證明這些塵埃來自古柏帶。

The researchers found minerals that formed when water interacted with dust early in the solar system's history. This ancient water was rich in heavier oxygen isotopes. Because similar signs are rare in meteorites, giant planets may have limited the mixing between the outer and inner solar system.
研究人員找到一些礦物，是在太陽系歷史早期、水和塵埃發生作用時形成的。這些遠古的水含有較多較重的氧同位素。由於隕石裡很少看到類似的特徵，巨大的行星可能限制了太陽系外圍和內側之間物質的混合。
words: 比較級 more ancient｜ancient history 古代史
複數 grains｜a grain of sand 一粒沙｜grains of dust 塵埃顆粒
adj. stratospheric 平流層的；極高的｜in the stratosphere 在平流層
複數 isotopes｜adj. isotopic｜oxygen isotopes 氧同位素
複數 meteorites｜n. meteor 流星｜n. meteoroid 流星體

analysis.zh: 研究人員找到一些礦物，是在太陽系歷史早期、水和塵埃發生作用時形成的。
parts: when 引導的時間副詞子句
early in the solar system's history.
analysis.note: 這句有兩層子句：that formed 說明是「什麼樣的礦物」，when water interacted with dust 再說明礦物「什麼時候」形成。interact with 是「和…相互作用」，科學文章很常用。

analysis.zh: 由於隕石裡很少看到類似的特徵，巨大的行星可能限制了太陽系外圍和內側之間物質的混合。
parts: Because similar signs are rare in meteorites,
between the outer and inner solar system.
analysis.note: may have + p.p. 表示對「過去」的推測：「可能曾經…」。科學家不能百分之百確定時，常用 may have / might have 讓語氣保留。Because 子句放句首時，後面要加逗號。

quiz.q: Where were the dust particles collected?
opts: In the Kuiper Belt by a spacecraft
quiz.ex: 第一、二段：dust collected high in Earth's own atmosphere，由 ER-2 高空研究機從平流層收集。

quiz.q: How many dust particles did the team study?
quiz.ex: 第二段：The team studied 12 dust particles。

quiz.q: What does the passage suggest about giant planets?
opts: They may have limited mixing between the outer and inner solar system.
They are made of ancient ice.
quiz.ex: 第三段：giant planets may have limited the mixing between the outer and inner solar system。

source.title: NASA Science：NASA Scientists Find Clues to Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune（2026/11/18）
